Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Mark Villar joins Senate majority bloc

blocks.text: Senate President Pro Tempore Tito Sotto III confirms Senator Mark Villar joins the Senate majority bloc.

items: BIR: Sara Duterte received income from Davao City in 2023 when she was VP

blocks.text: Bureau of Internal Revenue records show Vice President Sara Duterte received income from Davao City Hall in 2023 when she was already elected Vice President.

items: AFP evacuates soldier from Ayungin over medical issues

blocks.text: The Armed Forces of the Philippines says a Filipino soldier deployed to the BRP Sierra Madre in Ayungin Shoal has been evacuated.

items: In just 4 years, Marcos tops 2 predecessors in foreign travel budget, number of trips

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will head once again to a working visit to Singapore from October 7 to 11.

items: Poland’s Nawrocki meets Pacman: In Manila, diplomacy in boxing

blocks.text: Polish President Karol Nawrocki trains with boxing legend Manny Pacquiao during his visit to the Philippines. – Rappler.com
